question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Accurate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Faulty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accurate"** means something that is correct and free from errors; it represents precision or exactness. (सटीक)

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist provided an accurate measurement of the chemical composition.
 
 
 
• **"Faulty"** refers to something that is defective, imperfect, or contains errors. (त्रुटिपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** The report was rejected because it contained faulty data that led to incorrect conclusions.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Accurate"** is **"Faulty"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Faulty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Errorless** (त्रुटिरहित): Something free from mistakes or errors.

 
 
• **Example:** The errorless execution of the project earned praise from the manager.
 
 
 
• **Careful** (सावधान): Acting with caution and attention to avoid mistakes or harm.
 
 
• **Example:** She was very careful while handling the fragile glassware.
 
 
 
• **Correct** (सही): Free from errors and consistent with truth or accuracy.
 
 
• **Example:** His answer to the math problem was absolutely correct.
